lines.text: Every product we build from here will need to know things.
Today, each one carries its own copy. Its own wording. Its own idea of what is current. Build ten products, and you have ten versions of the truth, and ten places to fix when one sentence changes.
Verity treats knowledge like a utility. You plug in. You don't rebuild it.
Legal approves a sentence once, and every channel is told. The phone line. The chat. The advocate's screen. And the products nobody has built yet.
The rules travel with it. Who may see it. Whether it is still current. Who signed it off. Every product inherits them, and none has to invent them.
The advocate stops guessing. The member hears the same answer everywhere. And the next product starts with the hard part already done.
So, how long does mail order take?
Seven to ten business days. On the phone, in chat, and on the advocate's screen. One approved unit, worded for each channel, cited every time.
That is the point. Verity is not another app to check. It is the layer underneath. Built once, and everything we build next stands on it.
Verity. One approved truth, in every channel.
